title: Speaking — Meeting new people
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on meeting new people.

questions: Which season do you most look forward to?
Does the time of year affect what you wear?
What do you like doing in cooler weather?
Has the weather in your area changed since you were a child?
In what settings do you often meet new people?
What helps you start a conversation with a stranger?

part2.topic: Describe an unexpected conversation with someone you had just met.
part2.closing: and explain what made it stand out.

questions: Why do some public spaces encourage conversations between strangers?
How can universities help students meet people outside their own course?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to meeting new people?
